description: Spell ids of ranks whose effect is weaker than the rank before them in the client. A player keeps the stronger rank, so the spellranks emitter marks these inferior: true and nothing reads them as the highest learned rank.

sources.client: the effect amounts in data/builds/<build>/spellconst/<class>.json, the client's own numbers, compared rank against the rank before it within one id family (classic ids below 100000, Forever copies above)

floor_note: A floor, not a census: an inferior rank missing here is treated as the highest learned rank. The sweep that built this list is in design/reviews/2026-10-07-inferior-ranks.md.

inferior.basis: 55 ranged attack power against rank 5's 90 (14321), client 1.60.1.70009; the live Forever tooltip says 55 too
71 ranged attack power taken against rank 3's 98 (14324), client 1.60.1.70009; the Forever copy 1213268 of the same rank carries 110 and is the sound id
50 ranged attack power against rank 4's 75 (20905), client 1.60.1.70009
